title: Planning states a check's margin against the measured run-to-run spread when it orders measured figures
goal: kb/_self/backlog.md's sprint Plan rules and the kb-sprint skill's plan step say that a check which orders or bounds measured figures (timings, starts, memory) is written after the planner has measured the figures' run-to-run spread on the base or a prototype, and states its margin against that spread or asserts an exact difference the code makes by construction; the rule is a tested question of the kb-sprint:plan set

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import subprocess
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/rag.py', 'pack', '--root', '_self', '--set', 'kb-sprint:plan'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('rag.py pack --set kb-sprint:plan', p.returncode, p.stderr[-300:])
lines = [ln for ln in p.stdout.splitlines() if 'spread' in ln and 'margin' in ln]
assert lines, 'the kb-sprint:plan rule set holds no tested rule that a check ordering measured figures states its margin against a measured run-to-run spread'

clauses.clause: kb/_self/backlog.md's sprint Plan rules and the kb-sprint skill's plan step say that a check which orders or bounds measured figures (timings, starts, memory) is written after the planner has measured the figures' run-to-run spread on the base or a prototype
states its margin against that spread or asserts an exact difference the code makes by construction
the rule is a tested question of the kb-sprint:plan set
